speaker: mission_control

speaker: mission_control

spanish: Acércate despacio. No hay prisa por aparcar, {probe}.
english: Come in slowly. No rush to park, {probe}.

spanish: Una aproximación elegante, {probe}. Procura no estropearla al final.
english: An elegant approach, {probe}. Try not to spoil it at the end.

english: Docking range is being tracked. Small corrections, {probe}.
